input: my dad's test results came back and honestly i don't know, i've been in communication with mumcy but i'm holding am for mind

clauses.results came back: the event, stated flat because saying it slowly would cost more
clauses.honestly i don't know: not ignorance — the brace before exposure, and not-knowing feels like failing him
clauses.been in communication with mumcy: active coping, listed like it is nothing
clauses.holding am for mind: carrying it alone, on purpose, so nobody else has to

full_integration: Results back and you don't know — and the not-knowing is doing the work of guilt, like not having an answer means you failed him. You've been in communication, which is more than nothing, and you're still holding it for mind so nobody else has to carry it. That's two jobs. Which one were you planning to put down first?

input: work dey choke me

clauses.work dey choke me: overwhelm, not a throat — the volume has passed what can be held

full_integration: Choke — that's the word for when it's past what you can hold, not just heavy. What's the one thing on that pile that, if it moved, would let you breathe by Friday?

input: i'm fine
full_integration: Fine. That's the lid, not what's under it. You typed two words to a screen at this hour — the two words weren't the reason you came. What's under them?

input: my mumcy keeps calling and i don't pick, then i feel bad the whole day

clauses.keeps calling and i don't pick: avoidance that is costing more than it saves
clauses.i feel bad the whole day: the interest payment on the avoidance

full_integration: You dodge the call and then pay for it all day — so the avoidance isn't free, it just moves the cost somewhere you can't see it coming. Not picking buys you ten quiet minutes and eight bad hours. Picking costs you ten bad minutes. You already know both columns. What's the number she'd hear in your voice if you picked today?

input: i been applying since january, nothing. i'm tired

clauses.applying since january: eight months of effort nobody has counted

full_integration: Eight months of applying and the only thing that came back was nothing — that's tired earned, not tired given. The applying was work whether it landed or not. What did you stop doing in those eight months that you'd want back this week?

input: everybody don japa and i still dey here

clauses.everybody don japa: comparison, and the word everybody is doing damage
clauses.i still dey here: the sentence underneath it — stuck, and behind

full_integration: Everybody left and you're still here — and 'everybody' is the word doing the damage, because it makes staying look like a verdict instead of a Tuesday. Being here is not the same as being behind. Whose leaving is the one you're actually measuring yourself against?

input: i for don call am but wetin i go even talk

clauses.i for don call am: the intention already exists — this is not avoidance, it is a stuck start
clauses.wetin i go even talk: the script is the blocker, not the willingness

full_integration: You already want to call — the thing stopping you is not the calling, it's not having the sentence. So the sentence doesn't have to be good. 'I don't know what to say but I'm here' is nine words and it does the whole job. Which of those nine feels like a lie?

input: i think say na me cause am

clauses.na me cause am: guilt claiming authorship of something bigger than one person

full_integration: You're giving yourself the whole credit for something that had more than one hand in it — and guilt does that because being the cause is easier than being powerless. If you caused it, you can fix it. What's the part that was actually yours, not the whole thing?

input: money no dey and rent don near

clauses.money no dey: the fact, and the fear under it
clauses.rent don near: the clock, which is what makes it unbearable

full_integration: No money and a date coming — the date is what makes it sit in your stomach, not the amount. Ten naira and a plan feels different from ten naira and a countdown. What's the earliest true thing you could tell whoever collects it?

input: i be the first born so everything na my head

clauses.everything na my head: the load, stated as if it were natural law

affect: an obligation they did not choose
full_integration: First born, so the whole thing sits on your head — and nobody asked you if you wanted the job, you just aged into it. That's not a complaint, it's a description. What's one thing on that head that somebody else in the family is old enough to carry now?

input: i no fit sleep, my mind dey run

clauses.my mind dey run: the engine — a loop that cannot land

full_integration: The mind is running and sleep is what it's running over — that's a loop that can't land, not restlessness. Write down the one it keeps returning to, on paper, next to the bed. Not to solve it. To put it somewhere that isn't your head.

input: my oga talk say i no serious and i just kept quiet

clauses.i just kept quiet: what it cost — the swallowed reply

full_integration: He said it and you swallowed the answer — and the swallowing is the part still sitting in your throat, not the sentence he used. Quiet was the safe move in that room. What was the reply you didn't get to give?

input: i dey happy for my friend but i dey vex small too

clauses.i dey vex small too: also true, and the one they expect to be judged for

full_integration: Both are true at once and neither cancels the other — happy for him, vexed for you, and the vex is not a character flaw, it's arithmetic. You wanted the thing too. Say what the vex is actually about: him having it, or you not?

input: na the same thing every week

clauses.same thing every week: a pattern they named themselves — the most valuable sentence in the corpus

full_integration: Every week. You just named the thing — that's yours, and it took longer to see than to say. What's the part of the week where it starts?

input: traffic don spoil my day before i even reach office

clauses.before i even reach office: the day was decided before it began

full_integration: The road named your day before you got a vote — and that's the part that stings, not the hours. One thing inside the danfo is still yours. What are you doing with those forty minutes tomorrow?

input: my chest tight since morning

clauses.chest tight since morning: a body report with a timestamp

full_integration: Tight since morning — so it started before whatever you've been blaming it on. Four in, six out, and let the shoulder drop on the out. Once, now. Then tell me what happened last night.

input: i don try everything, nothing dey work

clauses.nothing dey work: hopelessness arriving through the door of effort

full_integration: Everything tried and nothing moved — that's not you failing, that's the ground not giving. But 'everything' is doing work in that sentence it can't back up. Name the last three. Let's see if they were three things or one thing three times.

input: i dey fear say i go end up like my papa

clauses.fear say i go end up like my papa: inherited fear, and a comparison already half-believed

full_integration: You're afraid of becoming him — and the fear is loud because part of you is checking for the resemblance daily. That checking is the tell that you're already different: he wasn't watching. What's the one thing he did that you've decided you won't?

input: she left and i never even fight for am

clauses.i never even fight for am: the regret, which is the actual injury

full_integration: She left and you didn't fight — and the not-fighting is what you're carrying, not the leaving. Sometimes not fighting is knowing. Sometimes it's freezing. Which one was it, honestly?

input: i just dey exist, i no dey live

clauses.i no dey live: the comparison to something they remember having

full_integration: Existing but not living — and you'd only know the difference if you'd had the other one. When did the switch happen? Not the reason. The week.

input: my sister dey do well and my mama dey compare us

clauses.my mama dey compare us: the actual injury — being measured by the person who should not measure

full_integration: Your sister doing well isn't the problem — your mother holding the two of you against each other is. That comparison started long before either of you had results. What's the version of you she'd have to stop comparing to see?

input: abeg i no wan talk about am

clauses.i no wan talk about am: a boundary, and it deserves to be honoured on the first ask

full_integration: Then we don't. It's still here whether you talk or not, and you don't owe it to a screen. What do you want instead — sit quiet, or something else entirely?

input: i dey feel like say i be burden for my family

clauses.i be burden for my family: shame, whole-self, not about a deed

full_integration: Burden. That's a word about who you are, not about anything you did — and shame always goes for the whole person because it's harder to argue with. I'm not going to talk you out of it. Who in that family told you that first, or did you build it yourself?

input: i get better job now but i still dey empty

clauses.i get better job now: the thing that was supposed to fix it
clauses.i still dey empty: the thing it did not fix

full_integration: You got the thing and the empty stayed — which means the empty was never about the job, and that's the harder news. What were you hoping the job would prove?

input: my friends no dey check up on me again
affect: isolation — check whether it is true or felt
full_integration: Nobody's checking in — and that lands heavier when you're already down, because down is when you notice the silence. When did you last go first? Not as a scold. As a question about which way the quiet is running.

input: i want japa but i no wan leave my mama alone

clauses.i no wan leave my mama alone: the other true pull, equally real

full_integration: Both are yours and both are real — wanting out, and not wanting her alone. This isn't a puzzle with an answer hiding in it; it's two loyalties. Three things you'd miss and three you'd gain, written tonight, not felt. Both lists.

input: i dey pray but e be like say God no dey hear
full_integration: You've kept praying and the silence kept coming back — and a silence you keep showing up to is heavier than one you gave up on. What would 'heard' have looked like? Say the specific thing.

input: i shout for my pikin today and i no fit forgive myself

clauses.i no fit forgive myself: guilt, which wants repair and is being denied it

full_integration: You shouted and now you won't let yourself off — but guilt is asking for repair, not punishment, and you're giving it the wrong one. Kids don't need parents who never shout. They need the part that comes after. What are you going to say to them tonight?

input: e be like say i dey waste my life

clauses.i dey waste my life: a verdict on the whole, delivered in a moment

full_integration: Wasting — that's a verdict on the whole thing, handed down on a random Tuesday by a tired person. Tired makes the whole look worse than the parts. What happened this week that made the sentence show up now?

input: work don finish me, i dey do 6am to 10pm

clauses.6am to 10pm: the number, which they offered as proof

full_integration: Sixteen hours. You gave me the number because you knew it would sound like too much said out loud — it is. That's not weakness arriving, that's arithmetic. What's the first hour you could take back, and who'd notice?

input: i no get person wey i fit tell

clauses.i no get person wey i fit tell: isolation, and the reason they are typing to a machine

full_integration: Nobody to tell — which is why this is where it's coming out, and that's not a small thing to admit. You're telling it now. Say the part you'd have said to them.

input: my body dey pain me but doctor talk say nothing dey

clauses.doctor talk say nothing dey: dismissal, which adds a second injury

full_integration: It hurts and you were told there's nothing there — so now you're carrying the pain and the doubt about your own pain. Being disbelieved is its own injury. Where in the body, exactly, and when is it loudest?

input: i keep starting things and never finish

clauses.keep starting things: capacity — starting is not the problem

affect: self-criticism with a pattern inside it
full_integration: You start easily and stop before the end — that's a pattern you just named yourself, which is worth more than any name I'd give it. Starting takes something. What happens at the point where you stop? Same point every time?

input: na my fault say the relationship spoil, i too dey do too much

clauses.i too dey do too much: a defence being named as a flaw

full_integration: You're taking the whole bill, and the thing you're calling a flaw — doing too much — protected you once. Somebody taught you that being needed was how you stayed. It cost you something here. What did doing too much buy you the first time?

input: i dey vex but i no fit talk am

clauses.i no fit talk am: the anger has nowhere to go, which is why it stays

affect: anger, usually standing in front of grief
full_integration: Vexed with nowhere to put it — and it sits in the throat because that's where the unsaid version lives. Anger's usually standing in front of something quieter. Say it here first: what's the sentence you can't say to them?

input: i see am on instagram and my whole day just scatter

clauses.my whole day just scatter: the size of the effect from a small input

full_integration: One post took the whole day — that's how much you were already carrying before you opened it, not how strong the post was. A highlight reel doesn't cost that much unless something was already thin. Mute that one account today. One. That's the task.

input: i dey fear say if i rest everything go collapse
full_integration: Rest is being held hostage by a belief that everything depends on you not stopping — and that belief has never been tested, only obeyed. What's the smallest thing you could stop for one day, that you already know wouldn't collapse?

input: na me dey hold this family together and nobody dey see am
full_integration: You're holding it and nobody's looking — and the not-being-seen is the heavier half, because the holding you'd do anyway. Who would notice first if you stopped? Not who should. Who would.

input: i dey do therapy for tiktok, e no dey work

clauses.therapy for tiktok: seeking help through what is available
clauses.e no dey work: disappointment in the method, not the wanting

full_integration: You've been trying to get it from thirty-second clips and it hasn't taken — that's the format's fault, not yours. The wanting was right. What's the thing you were hoping one of them would say?

input: my papa never tell me say he proud of me

clauses.my papa never tell me say he proud of me: an absence, decades long, still live

full_integration: Never once. That's not a small absence — it's a thing you've been listening for so long that the listening became a habit. What would you have done with it if he'd said it at twelve?

input: i dey manage, i no wan complain, others get am worse

clauses.others get am worse: the comparison used as a gag

full_integration: You're using other people's worse to keep your own quiet — and that's a gag, not perspective. Somebody having it harder has never once made a thing lighter. What would you say if the comparison wasn't allowed?

input: my rent don increase 40% and i just dey laugh

clauses.i just dey laugh: laughing as the only available response

input: i dey feel say person dey follow me for road

clauses.person dey follow me for road: a specific fear with a location

full_integration: Someone behind you on the road — that's your body doing its oldest job, whether or not it's right. Where in the body did you feel it before you turned? And has it happened on the same stretch twice?

input: my guy borrow money and now e dey avoid me

clauses.now e dey avoid me: the real loss — the friendship, not the cash

input: i be graduate but i dey do menial work, i dey shame

clauses.i be graduate but i dey do menial work: the gap between expectation and now

input: i no sabi wetin i want again

clauses.i no sabi wetin i want again: the word 'again' is doing all the work — they used to know

input: person wey i trust talk my business give people

input: i just tire for everything, even the things wey i like

input: i dey plan my papa burial and i never even cry

clauses.i never even cry: the thing they are worried about themselves for

input: every time i try talk to am, e turn to fight
full_integration: You keep going in for the conversation and coming out of a fight — and you've done it enough times to call it 'every time', which means you've been the one trying. This is a long game, not one round. What does the fight always start over? Not what it's about. What it starts over.

input: i dey okay honestly, i just wan see wetin this app dey do

clauses.i just wan see wetin this app dey do: the cover story, and a real one

input: i am useless, i cannot do anything right, everybody at work can see it

And the part doing the damage is that everybody at work can see it, so you are carrying it in public with no place to put it down. What would it cost to let exactly one person watch you get something wrong?

input: i be failure, my mates don pass me, i no good for anything

input: i keep telling myself i'm stupid for taking this job and i can't stop

clauses.i'm stupid for taking this job: a whole decision collapsed into a word about the decider
clauses.i can't stop: the rumination is the symptom they can actually feel

full_integration: You keep telling yourself stupid, and the telling has turned into its own job — that is the part costing you, more than the job is. That sentence is not information about you; it is a loop wearing your voice. What did taking it give you that you would not hand back?

input: everybody dey grow, na me dey here, i weak

clauses.everybody dey grow: the comparison set is everyone, so the gap can never close
clauses.na me dey here: stillness read as personal fault rather than as a season
clauses.i weak: the single word carrying the whole verdict

full_integration: Everybody dey grow and na you dey here — na the sentence, and 'weak' na the word you take finish am. But na their timeline you dey measure with, and nobody ever show you their own waiting. Which thing you don carry this year wey nobody see?

input: i feel worthless since the promotion went to someone else

clauses.i feel worthless: worth, not disappointment — the leap is the finding
clauses.since the promotion: a datable moment, so something specific did the cutting
clauses.went to someone else: the comparison is a person, which is why it stings past the role

full_integration: Worthless since the promotion — one decision, in one room, and it went straight past disappointment to what you are worth. That leap is the thing worth looking at. What did you tell yourself it would prove about you if you had got it?

input: there is no point, nothing ever changes, i have tried this before and it always goes back

clauses.nothing ever changes: the totalising claim the conclusion rests on
clauses.i have tried this before: evidence — they are not lazy, they have run the experiment
clauses.it always goes back: the specific shape of the disappointment

input: e no go better, why i go bother, this country no dey change

clauses.this country no dey change: the frame is structural, so personal effort reads as pointless

input: hopeless. i don try everything and nothing dey work

clauses.hopeless: one word, said alone, which is its own information
clauses.i don try everything: effort already spent — this is tiredness, not avoidance

full_integration: Hopeless, and you don try everything — that word carry the tiredness of person wey work, no be person wey siddon. Na the trying wey no pay be the injury here. Wetin you try wey come closest before e slip?

input: why bother applying again, they never reply, it's been eight months

input: nothing go change for my family, na so e dey since, i tire

clauses.nothing go change for my family: the hopelessness is about people, not circumstances
clauses.i tire: the tiredness of carrying something you did not begin

input: i am stuck between staying for my mother and taking the offer in abuja, i can't decide and it has been three weeks

clauses.stuck between staying for my mother: one side is duty, and it has a face
clauses.taking the offer in abuja: the other side is a life, and it has a deadline
clauses.i can't decide: not indecision — both are real, so choosing means losing something true
clauses.it has been three weeks: the not-deciding is itself costing time nobody is counting

full_integration: Stuck between your mother and Abuja — and stuck is right, because both sides are true, not because you are weak at choosing. Three weeks of holding two real things is its own work, and nobody has been paying you for it. Say the Abuja side out loud, in full, with nothing softened. What does that side actually want?

input: i dey confuse, my papa want make i marry now, my own mind no gree, i just dey look ground

clauses.my papa want make i marry now: the timeline belongs to somebody else

clauses.i just dey look ground: the body has taken the position the mouth cannot

input: i have to prove myself every single day at that office or i am not enough, it has been like this since i was small

clauses.have to prove myself every single day: the proving resets nightly, so it can never be finished
clauses.or i am not enough: the stake is identity, which is why the effort never feels optional
clauses.since i was small: the rule predates the office — it was learned somewhere with less at stake

full_integration: Prove yourself every single day or you are not enough — and it resets every night, so there is no version of this where you ever get to be done. That rule was not written at that office; you brought it in with you, since you were small. How old were you when you first learned that being enough had to be earned?

input: i must perform before dem go respect me for house, na so e dey since i be pikin

clauses.i must perform before dem go respect me: respect is conditional and the condition is output
clauses.for house: the audience is family, so there is nowhere to rest from it
clauses.na so e dey since i be pikin: an old rule, inherited, not chosen

full_integration: Perform before dem go respect you — so respect na something wey you dey rent, and rent never finish. And na for house, wey suppose be the one place wey you fit siddon. That rule old pass the work; you carry am since you be pikin. Wetin be the age wey you first learn say na wetin you produce dem dey count?

input: every morning i wake up and the first thing in my head is the rent, then transport, then what i owe my brother, and by the time i reach the office i have already argued with three people who are not there, and then i sit down and pretend i am okay until it starts again tomorrow

clauses.then transport, then what i owe my broth: a queue, in order, rehearsed enough to have an order

clauses.i sit down and pretend i am okay: the performance starts at the desk and costs its own energy
clauses.until it starts again tomorrow: the loop is named by them, which is the most useful thing in the message

full_integration: You argue with three people who are not there before you even reach the office — that is a full day of work done before the day starts. And you named the loop yourself: rent, transport, your brother, pretend, repeat. That thing has a shape and a schedule, and it is not you. If it had a name, what would you call the version of it that shows up at 6am?

input: na the same thing every week, i wake up, i check account, i see wetin remain, i tell myself say e go better by month end, i go work, i come back, i no talk to anybody for house, i just enter room, and by morning the same fear go don return before i even open my eyes

clauses.i tell myself say e go better by month e: the promise they make to themselves to get through the morning
clauses.i no talk to anybody for house: the withdrawal is deliberate and it has a cost nobody is counting
clauses.the same fear go don return before i eve: it arrives ahead of consciousness, so there is no clean minute

full_integration: Na you talk am yourself — the same thing every week — and that sentence na the sharpest thing for this whole message. The fear dey reach before you even open eye, so you never get one clean minute to start from. And you no dey talk to anybody for house, so na you and am alone every night. If that weekly thing be person wey dey wait for you every morning, wetin you go call am?

input: i know exactly what this is. it's the firstborn thing, i've read about it, i can trace it back to being nine years old and being told to be the responsible one. i understand the mechanism completely. and i still pick up every call, still send the money i don't have, still say yes before my brain catches up. knowing has changed nothing

clauses.i know exactly what this is: the analysis arrives finished, with nothing asked of it
clauses.i can trace it back to being nine years: the origin is located, which felt like it should be enough
clauses.i understand the mechanism completely: they are not avoiding the feeling, they are narrating it
clauses.still say yes before my brain catches up: the body moves before the understanding can reach it
clauses.knowing has changed nothing: they are reporting the failure of their own method while using it

full_integration: You understand this better than most people ever will, and you just said the thing nobody says back to you: it hasn't moved. That's not you failing at it — you got the understanding completely right and it turned out not to be the lever. So here's the question the understanding can't answer. Tonight, if you were never going to understand this any better than you already do, what would you actually do the next time the phone rings?

input: i sabi say na my childhood cause am, i don read plenty about am, i fit even explain am give you like say na textbook. but every single time my mama call, i go still dey do the same thing. i dey watch myself do am. e no dey change anything

clauses.i fit even explain am give you like say: they can teach the subject they are stuck inside
clauses.i dey watch myself do am: the watching is happening and it is not helping
